hotspots.title: Trump-Putin Diesel Deal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's agreement to import Russian diesel fuel has drawn intense international condemnation, particularly from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who labeled the deal terrible for war efforts. Trump responded by attacking Zelenskyy and urging Ukrainians to replace him, further inflaming diplomatic tensions.
hotspots.affect: Commands white-hot international outrage over breaking wartime energy sanctions and perceived capitulation to Russia for domestic price relief.

hotspots.title: Frp Populist Surge & Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Norway's Progress Party (FrP) has surged to become the country's largest party at 33.2% in new polling, commanding an overwhelming 53% among voters under 30. However, this historic surge is accompanied by internal turbulence, including public distrust over party funding allocation and disputes over media coverage.
hotspots.affect: Combines triumphant populist electoral momentum with intense internal leadership friction and public scrutiny.

hotspots.title: Trump Administration Legal Battles
hotspots.blurb: The U.S. Department of Justice has launched an antitrust investigation targeting major television networks that halted White House pool coverage after the administration banned selected outlets. Meanwhile, the administration faces concurrent legal challenges over border land designations and local law enforcement mask bans.
hotspots.affect: Generates severe alarm and friction around constitutional limits, freedom of the press, and retaliatory executive power.

hotspots.title: Tech‑Sector Visa Attack
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has escalated its push against skilled foreign worker programs, suspending Microsoft from green card sponsorship and imposing AI security reporting requirements. Remarks by Vice President JD Vance comparing H-1B workers to indentured servants have drawn sharp official condemnation from India.
hotspots.affect: Fueled by nationalistic economic protectionism, anti-immigrant framing, and high-stakes diplomatic blowback.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Blitz
hotspots.blurb: President Trump and Vice President JD Vance are conducting a high-tempo midterm rally tour across battleground states, bringing figures like Mike Tyson on stage and making sweeping proposals such as $5,000 annual citizen payouts. The rallies aim to energize the Republican base and boost midterm turnout.
hotspots.affect: Driven by populist campaign fervor, dramatic spectacle, and high-stakes electoral mobilization.
